source_excerpt: Except for T. fournieri, these plants were automatically self pollinating
review_note: The methods explicitly include Lindernia antipoda among the plants grown and state that, except for T. fournieri, the plants automatically self-pollinated. POWO 2026 accepts Bonnaya antipoda and includes Lindernia antipoda as a synonym.

source_excerpt: None of these plants exhibited self incompatibility
review_note: The same experimental material is explicitly reported not to exhibit self-incompatibility. This supports SC independently of the autonomous-selfing mapping, but both traits resolve the same reproductive-assurance species-axis cell.

source_excerpt: Durio graveolens, D. griffithii, and D. zibethinus are partially self-incompatible
review_note: Controlled bagging, hand-self and hand-cross treatments support partial self-incompatibility. Encode conservatively as mixed_or_variable rather than forcing SI. This is a direct fill for D. graveolens and a counterexample to any simple genus-wide Durio=SI rule.
